title: Meme Maze
description: Swipe through 23 memes, react, and light the candles.

vibes.question: Hey Puddin'. Joker has his jokes shortly aside. What is your vibe?

options.explanation: Chaos begins best when you're eager... Your vibes charged!

options.text: That song you shared last night. Somewhere. Still got me sniffling
options.explanation: Music scars cut deeper than jokes... you unlocked a softer Joker-side. That's his fav song btw.

vibes.question: The circus lights flicker... Joker taunts again. How do you reply?

options.explanation: The chaos crown fits, and you wear it proudly — onward to the memes!

options.text: Hold on, let me breathe first
options.explanation: Patience is power, Harley. I like that about you. I smirk but let you take a pause.

vibes.question: Final vibe-check before you enter the Meme Maze... what’s your move?

options.text: Light me my candles, I’m ready
options.explanation: Perfect. Let’s burn bright. Remember, you said he is a bright light since you met him...

options.text: Can’t we just skip to the punchline?
options.explanation: Skipping is for quitters... Joker has 'drugged' you into this Meme Maze anyway.
